summary: Finished the three things the engine named. First, internal/fitnessrules/yaml_scalar_test.go is the reviewer's test again: logic unchanged, with a trailing newline added so it is gofmt-clean. It passes on the fixed .taad/fitness.yaml and fails on the attempt-1 file at lines 421 and 423. My wider scanner and its tests moved to yaml_scalar_scan_test.go; the corpus is internal/fitnessrules/testdata/yaml_scalars.json. Second, C-005's command was a multi-test `-run` with `|` inside a slash pattern, which go splits per subtest level and the engine could not take as one test. It is now the single test TestCommentRemove/already-hidden. Third, C-013's command exited 1 by design, so the engine read it as failing. It now runs tests/acceptance/check_e006_1_stops_at_block.py, which exits 0 only when the planted E-006 line-1 body passes outright or stops solely at the block press (404 on /admin/users/<id>/block). Checked on both paths: with the body planted in the tree, and with it read from the ledger read-only into a scratch copy. It fails (exit 1) when the removal route is broken and exits 2 when there is no body. Full suite and go vet pass; each case command passes as written.

obligations.how: TestCommentRemove/leaf feeds a lone writer's only top-level comment through the owner POST: 303, login, text and id gone for anonymous, reader and owner, count 2 comments to 1 comment. TestRemove/leaf covers the store.

TestCommentRemove/held: the reply three levels deep with a visible reply, then the reply above it, each a bare nested placeholder with no form, login or body; count 4, 3, 2. TestRemove/held covers the store.
TestCommentRemove/chain-collapses: the last visible reply under two placeholders; three nodes collapse, count drops 2 to 1, ids 2-4 absent from the source.
TestCommentRemove/below-cap: a 300-deep chain over HTTP; depth 7 and the end of the chain are removed through the branch-page control, count 300 to 298. TestRemove/deep-300 covers the store.

TestCommentRemove/already-hidden (blocked then removed, block lifted, still hidden; removed twice keeps the first removed_at) plus TestRemove/already-removed, TestRemove/blocked-writer-commutes and TestCountReconciles in internal/comments. Case command is now the single test TestCommentRemove/already-hidden.
TestCommentRemove/ids: x, 0, 01, +1, -1, an overflow, an unknown id and a deleted report's comment, each with no body, a form and an oversize body: 404, nothing removed.

TestCommentRemove/refused: anonymous, signed-in reader, reader with the owner's login on id 999 and cross-site POSTs get 403; the owner's GET and HEAD get 405; removed_at stays NULL; observe() in TestDislikesDoNotInterfere has the route for the three non-owners.
TestCommentRemove/landing: from absent, from=admin, another or repeated or empty value, a body over 1 KiB, and a comment on a published-then-unpublished report and on a never-published draft.

TestRemoveControl, TestThreadViewerCanRemove and the added assertions in TestReaderPagesShareOneLayout: one control per shown comment for the owner on /, /reports/x and a branch page, none on placeholders, none for a reader or a visitor, the owner's two pages the same bytes.

TestCommentCount: 0, 1 ('1 comment') and many, placeholders, a blocked writer's comments, comments below the cap; count equals the database's COUNT under the visibility predicate, exactly one number beside a comments label, none on the branch page.
TestAdminCommentList: flat pre-order list through 12 levels, a reply under a placeholder, no removed text, forms with from=admin, a draft report's list and removal.
TestRemoveReadFailure: with the a.tree seam failing, reader pages are 503 with no count line, the admin report page is 500, and the removal still answers 303.

Case command is now `python -I tests/acceptance/check_e006_1_stops_at_block.py`, which exits 0 when the planted line-1 body (planted in the tree, or read read-only from the ledger into a scratch copy) either passes or fails with exactly one failure, the press helper's status assertion on POST /admin/users/<id>/block answering 404. Observed on this tree on both paths: exit 0 with `AssertionError: 404 not less than 400 : the owner's POST /admin/users/8003/block answered 404`. With the removal route renamed it exits 1 on `POST /admin/comments/9/remove answered 404`; with no body available it exits 2. look() runs after posting and after each of the three removals (L410, L413, L416, L419) before the block press (L420), so the stop proves they passed.

TestStoreFaultSteps covers adminCommentRemove (identify, look up by renaming reports, remove by a BEFORE UPDATE OF removed_at trigger) and adminReport (identify, report, votes, feedback, feedback replies, comments via the seam), with fresh targets, a writeFault kind and the widened doc comment; 26 subtests.

Added `(?i)\bremoved_at\s*=\s*NULL\b` to 'removal never deletes a comment row' and named the known holes in its because; a throwaway test showed it fires on `SET removed_at = NULL` in any case or spacing and stays quiet on the COALESCE UPDATE, IS NULL and = 0.

obligations.how: The because of 'removal never deletes a comment row' is a single-quoted scalar with apostrophes doubled. internal/fitnessrules/yaml_scalar_test.go is the reviewer's TestFitnessYAMLPlainScalarsParse with its logic unchanged (only a trailing newline added); it passes on the fixed file and fails on the attempt-1 file at fitness.yaml:421 and :423. The class 'fitness.yaml text that a YAML reader refuses and the lenient loader accepts' is enumerated in internal/fitnessrules/testdata/yaml_scalars.json: 54 rows by who writes the text (prose, pattern and glob authors), covering ': ', a trailing ':', ' #', continuation lines that read as keys, single-quote apostrophes, double-quote escapes, leading * & [ { @ and backtick, list items that read as mappings, tabs, and CRLF aliases. TestFitnessYAMLScalarCorpus runs every row through yamlScalarRefusals in yaml_scalar_scan_test.go; TestFitnessYAMLCorpusCoversEveryCarrier is the census (every key the real fitness.yaml uses must be a named carrier with a refuse and an accept row); TestFitnessYAMLFileHasNoRefusedScalars runs the scanner over the real file. Removing each scanner check fails the rows that pin it. The engine's Fitness op=check was not available to me and no YAML parser is installed; the corpus oracle is the YAML spec and the engine's own quoted error.
